title: Photovoltaic Energy Systems
description: Graduate-level course covering photovoltaic (PV) energy systems, including power converter configurations, safety standards and regulations, and the design, modeling, analysis, and control of DC-DC and DC-AC converters. Topics include voltage regulation, digital control techniques for single-phase and three-phase PV systems, maximum power point tracking (MPPT), battery energy storage integration, standalone and grid-connected PV operation, transient and steady-state analysis, and computer-based simulation of PV systems.
details: Design and analysis of photovoltaic energy systems
DC-DC and DC-AC power converter configurations
Digital control for single-phase and three-phase systems

title: Electric Drives
description: Graduate-level course on AC/DC electric machine drives for speed and position control, integrating electric machines, power electronics, and control systems. Covers power electronic converters for DC and AC motor drives, electromechanical energy conversion, and the design, construction, operation, and control of DC, induction, permanent magnet, stepper, and switched reluctance machines. Includes feedback controller design for motor drive systems and applications in electric transportation, robotics, industrial process control, and energy efficiency.
details: AC and DC motor drive systems
Power electronic converters for machine control
Design and control of electric machines

title: Malware Analysis
description: Introduction to reverse engineering techniques for malware identification, classification, and analysis using disassembly, virtual machines, static analysis, and dynamic analysis methods. Focuses on understanding malicious software behavior through practical investigation in controlled environments.

title: Computer Architecture
description: Study of processor architecture taxonomies and system building blocks, including instruction set architectures, processors, memory hierarchies, I/O systems, computer buses, and peripheral devices. Covers system-level design concepts and applications to microcontrollers in embedded and real-time systems, with attention to power management and cybersecurity considerations. Includes discussion of fundamental physical and theoretical limits on processor performance and design.
details: Memory hierarchy and I/O system design

title: Fundamentals of Electromagnetics
description: Study of static electric and magnetic fields, time-varying electromagnetic fields, and Maxwell’s equations, with emphasis on RF circuit applications. Covers RF circuit components, transmission line behavior, impedance matching, and wave propagation concepts as applied to high-frequency systems. Includes applications to electromagnetic interference (EMI) and electromagnetic compatibility (EMC), and their impact on RF circuit design and performance.

title: Signals and Systems
description: Study of continuous-time and discrete-time signal modeling and linear system analysis. Covers Fourier analysis and frequency response, sampling theory, and filtering techniques. Includes Laplace and Z-transform methods, transfer functions, and system behavior characterization in both time and frequency domains.

title: Intermediate Programming (C Language)
description: Intermediate-level programming course focused on software development using the C programming language. Covers program design principles, algorithm development, and fundamental data structures. Emphasizes structured programming, problem-solving techniques, and efficient implementation of algorithms in C.

title: Web Programming
description: Course focused on web programming with emphasis on creating interactive and dynamic websites. Covers core front-end technologies including HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, as well as client-server architecture and web application development principles.
details: Frontend development with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript

title: Multi-Agent Systems
description: Study of agent-based AI systems with focus on reinforcement learning, game theory, and complex systems. Explores how autonomous agents learn, make decisions, and interact within shared environments. Emphasizes coordination strategies among multiple agents and how local interactions can lead to emergent global behavior in robotic and intelligent systems.
details: Applications in robotics and intelligent systems

title: Hardware Public-Key Cryptography
description: Study of modern public-key cryptography (PKC) with emphasis on hardware-oriented implementations and post-quantum cryptography. Covers arithmetic in Galois fields, elliptic curve cryptography, and emerging post-quantum schemes. Explores practical applications of PKC in securing data such as text, images, and video. Includes hands-on design work involving implementation methodologies and hardware platforms for cryptographic systems.
details: Hardware platform integration for PKC systems

title: Internet of Things Design
description: Study of the theory, design, and applications of microprocessors and microprocessor-based systems with emphasis on Internet of Things (IoT) technologies. Covers programming techniques for microcomputers, system integration, and the role of commercial microprocessors and semiconductor memory systems in embedded IoT device development. Includes design and implementation considerations for connected embedded systems.

title: Fundamentals of Electronic Circuits
description: Comprehensive study of analysis and design of linear and nonlinear electronic circuits using both discrete components and integrated circuits. Covers device modeling, circuit behavior, and practical design methodologies, with strong emphasis on hands-on laboratory experimentation and computer-aided simulation. Focuses on building intuition for real-world circuit performance, testing, and iterative design optimization across a wide range of electronic systems.
details: Analysis of linear and nonlinear circuits

title: Computer Engineering
description: Comprehensive study of the organization, architecture, and hardware design of digital and computer systems. Covers digital logic design, computer architecture principles, and implementation of computing systems using programmable logic devices. Includes hands-on laboratory work involving hardware description languages, simulation, and physical or virtual prototyping of digital circuits. Emphasizes understanding system-level design, performance trade-offs, and integration of hardware and software components in modern computing systems. Includes 3 hours of lecture and 3 hours of laboratory work. Letter grade only.
details: Integration of hardware and software systems

title: Electronics
description: In-depth study of electronic device applications including diodes, BJTs, and MOSFETs in both analog and digital circuit design. Covers transient and s-domain analysis techniques, including frequency response characterization using Bode plots. Emphasizes practical circuit analysis, design intuition, and validation through laboratory experimentation and computer-based simulation tools.

title: Computing Tools III
description: Advanced course focused on modern development tools used in computer science, informatics, and engineering workflows. Covers deployment of remote services, advanced project management systems, and automation through shell scripting. Emphasizes practical proficiency with development environments, tooling pipelines, and productivity-enhancing engineering practices used in professional software and systems development.

title: Mechanical Design And CAD Prototyping
description: Hands-on mechanical design and prototyping of functional systems and consumer-style devices using CAD modeling, mechanical principles, and iterative design validation. Focus on real-world usability, assembly constraints, and manufacturability.
details: 3D CAD modeling and mechanical assembly design
Development of functional mechanical systems (gears, locks, holders, clock mechanisms)
Kinematic and structural design of interactive mechanical devices
Rapid prototyping and iteration of physical concepts

title: Embedded Systems And IoT Development
description: Design and simulation of embedded systems and IoT-enabled devices for real-time sensing, monitoring, and control applications. Focus on system integration between hardware sensors, microcontrollers, and software analytics.
details: IoT system architecture and sensor integration

title: Power Electronics And Electric Drive Systems
description: Modeling, simulation, and control of power electronic systems and electric machine drives for efficient energy conversion and motor control applications.
details: DC-DC and DC-AC converter design and simulation
Motor control techniques including FOC and DTC
Renewable energy integration (PV and battery systems)
Performance optimization of power conversion systems

title: Cybersecurity, Malware Analysis And Cryptography
description: Study and implementation of cybersecurity techniques including malware reverse engineering and modern cryptographic systems with emphasis on secure computing and quantum-resistant methods.
details: Reverse engineering using debugging tools and VMs

title: Software Development And Systems Programming
description: Software engineering and systems programming using low-level and web-based technologies with focus on algorithms, structured programming, and interactive applications.
details: C-based systems programming and algorithm design

title: AI Systems And Multi-Agent Modeling
description: Development and simulation of intelligent systems including self-learning agents and multi-agent environments with emphasis on emergent behavior and adaptive decision-making.

title: Electromagnetics And RF System Modeling
description: Analysis and simulation of electromagnetic systems including RF circuits, wave propagation, and field interactions for high-frequency and power applications.
details: RF circuit and transmission line modeling
Impedance matching and wave behavior studies
Simulation of field interactions in physical systems

title: Control Systems And Physical Simulation
description: Mathematical modeling and simulation of dynamic systems including motors, solenoids, and energy systems using control theory and numerical simulation tools.
details: Motor control system modeling and simulation
Simulation of physical and energy systems
